summary: Iteration 13 backend + frontend testing for PSAK 72 PYMHD pipeline panel and reverse cost deletion. All 7 backend tests PASS (pipeline endpoint for admin/finance/operation, warning gate without confirm, confirmed delete + 4101/2390 reversal journal with is_reversal=true, non-last cost no-warning, invoiced AWB no-reversal). All targeted frontend flows VERIFIED end-to-end (Dashboard PYMHD panel and Costs page double-confirm dialog + reversal toast).
verified_features: GET /api/dashboard/pymhd-pipeline returns total_count, total_amount, recognized_amount, unrecognized_amount, by_status (Open/Reconciled), by_customer sorted DESC by amount — admin, finance, AND operation all 200.

DELETE /api/costs/{cid} without ?confirm on LAST cost of recognized-revenue AWB returns ok=false, needs_confirmation=true, Indonesian warning containing 'COST TERAKHIR', awb_number, and reversal_amount. Cost is NOT deleted yet.

DELETE /api/costs/{cid}?confirm=true returns ok=true and reversal.reversed=true with amount matching awb.total_tariff. Cost is deleted. awb.revenue_recognized=false confirmed via GET /api/orders/{id}. Journal entry with reference_type='awb_revenue_reversal', is_reversal=true, lines DR 4101 / CR 2390 confirmed via GET /api/journal.
Non-last cost deletion (AWB has 2 costs): DELETE first cost without confirm → ok=true directly, no needs_confirmation, no reversal.
Already-invoiced AWB: DELETE last cost ?confirm=true returns ok=true and reversal=null (no reversal posted) because PYMHD has already been cleared to Piutang via invoice.

Frontend /dashboard (admin): PYMHD Pipeline card visible with data-testid='pymhd-pipeline-panel'. pymhd-total=Rp 8.247.000 (92 AWB), pymhd-unrecognized=Rp 5.202.000, pymhd-recognized=Rp 3.045.000. Status breakdown shows Open:87 / Reconciled:5. Top customer rows pymhd-cust-row-0 through row-2 populated (only 3 customers in pipeline; row-3/row-4 not rendered, matching .slice(0,5) semantics).

Frontend /costs (operation): Created AWB UI-IT13-* with single Vendor cost. Clicking trash button triggers TWO confirm dialogs in sequence: (1) 'Hapus biaya?' and (2) '⚠️ PERINGATAN PSAK 72' containing the full Indonesian warning with AWB number and reversal amount Rp 900.000. After accepting both, cost row disappears and toast.warning shows 'Revenue recognition Rp 900.000 dibalik kembali ke PYMHD untuk UI-IT13-1781621237.'
action_items: MINOR: Trash/delete button in /app/frontend/src/pages/Costs.js L123 has no data-testid. Recommend adding data-testid={`delete-cost-${c.id}`} for stable automated regression. Functionality works correctly; selector currently relies on row's last <button>.
critical_code_review_comments: post_journal extra_fields injection (L371-432) correctly stamps is_reversal=true on reversal entries — verified via GET /api/journal.

delete_cost(L1248-1320) order of operations is correct: check 'is_last' BEFORE delete, gate via confirm flag, then delete cost + its journal cascade, then post reversal journal and reset revenue_recognized — atomic enough for current scope.
Pipeline endpoint correctly excludes Invoiced/Paid AWBs (filters status in ['Open','Reconciled']) and sorts by_customer DESC by amount as required.
Cost.delete uses two-step confirm() — works in browser but blocks UI thread. For future iteration consider a non-blocking custom modal (shadcn AlertDialog) for better UX.
Costs.js delete button lacks data-testid; minor maintainability gap.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created multiple TEST-IT13-* AWBs with Vendor costs (TEST_IT13_VENDOR / V1 / V2 / INVD). Frontend test created UI-IT13-1781621237 AWB which was then deleted via UI (cost removed, revenue recognition reversed back to PYMHD).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13_pymhd_reversal.py — run with python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iteration13_pymhd_reversal.py -v. AWB create requires service='LCL'/'FCL'/'LTL'/'FTL'/'AIR' and via='D'/'L'/'U' (literal). Cost create requires both 'cost_category' and 'category' fields. /api/journal returns a list directly (not wrapped). For Playwright dialog handling, register page.on('dialog', handler) BEFORE clicking delete; the handler must asyncio.create_task(d.accept()) since the listener is sync.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all features working as specified.
